text.en:
Section eight of Act Numbered Nineteen hundred and fifty-two, entitled "An Act to provide for
the tax on establishment of the Province of Batanes; to amend paragraph seven of section sixty-eight of Act
Numbered Eleven hundred and eighty-nine in certain particulars; to authorize the provincial board of the
Province of Batanes, with the approval of the Governor-General, to extend the time for the payment without
penalty of taxes and licenses; to amend section five of Act Numbered Fifteen hundred and eighty-two, entitled
'The Election Law,' by increasing the number of delegates to the Philippine Assembly to eighty-one, and for
other purposes," is hereby repealed.
Enacted, February 8, 1913.
